subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-path display by default, switch agent-visible paths to full paths, or add an explicit full-path mode?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally compact home paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and changing it affects UX, privacy, docs, and possible config surface.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve compact home-path display while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable path rewrites.

options.title: Switch Default To Full Paths
options.body: Make agent-visible path output use full paths everywhere and update prompts, docs, and regression tests consistently.

options.title: Add Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep the compact default but add a documented opt-in for users who need full paths in responses and tool displays.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve compact home-path display while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable path rewrites.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the central display helper and broader compact-home output direction that this issue challenges.
